title: Income Tax Act, 2025 to Replace 1961 Act from April 1, 2026 — 'PRARAMBH 2026' Launched
summary: FM Sitharaman launches PRARAMBH 2026 campaign and Income Tax Website 2.0 as India replaces the 65-year-old Income Tax Act 1961.

blocks.content: FM Nirmala Sitharaman launched **'PRARAMBH 2026'** (Policy Reform and Responsible Action for Mission Viksit Bharat) and **Income Tax Website 2.0**, preparing taxpayers for the new Income Tax Act, 2025 taking effect **April 1, 2026**.

items: **M.A.N.A.V. Framework**: Moral & Ethical Systems, Accountable Governance, National Sovereignty, Accessible & Inclusive AI, Valid & Legitimate Systems.
